ASTRA: FIRST PRIVATE RESEARCH RECORD
9 October 2026, Brisbane / 8 October 2026, UTC

PURPOSE AND STATUS

This is a private first-pass research record: original mathematical deductions,
proof reconstructions, adversarial checks, and reproducible finite experiments.
The leading result is a candidate exponential maximum-state-size lower bound
for a precisely specified invariant interpretation model. Its strongest audit
status is recorded below and in the accompanying reports.

No 10/10 breakthrough, established historical novelty, general complexity-class
separation, external certification, or proof-assistant verification is claimed.
“Independent”, “blind”, “reviewer”, and “audit” in these reports refer to separate
internal AI reconstructions/checks, not independent human specialist review.
Agreement among these checks is useful evidence, not external validation.

The archive contains original reports/code/results only. Downloaded full papers,
repository source files, credentials, and unrelated operational records are
excluded. No public repository write, publication, external outreach, or paid
computation is part of this record.

READING ORDER

1. proof_mining/EXPONENTIAL_INTERPRETATION_SPACE_CANDIDATE.md
   Current leading mathematical mechanism and exact model boundary.
2. hf_audit/HF_TRANSFER_AND_ENCODING_AUDIT.md
   Hereditarily finite-set transfer, fixed-width encoding, and state-size audit.
3. vector_cofilling/uniform_vector_cofilling_audit.md
   The coefficient quantifiers and published expansion input.
4. entropy_audit/GENERAL_CENTRAL_ENTROPY_THEOREM.md
   The generalized central-state theorem, not only its factorial special case.
5. entropy_audit/PRIOR_ART_COMPARISON.md
   Precise overlap with established entanglement results and remaining novelty
   uncertainty. An unresolved source-rendering issue is not an erratum claim.
6. contact_audit/AUDIT_REPORT.md and contact/CONTACT_REPORT.md
   A finite logarithmic-contact obstruction with two exact certificates.

Earlier scalar-cofilling and characteristic-two files remain as derivations and
negative controls. Their square-root exponent and original family177 expansion
input are superseded for the main candidate. The current route uses published
Kaufman–Oppenheim–Weinberger input and can work over F_3, avoiding characteristic-
two gadget changes. The Gaussian-channel report is a separate elementary route
